messages:
harper: hi team, just opened my first PR to rename a couple helpers. quick questions: preferred branch name, commit message format, and do tiny internal refactors need changelog entries?
mike: welcome harper! branch: refactor/<short-desc> or chore/<short-desc>. keep it concise.
aj: commit messages: present-tense one-line summary. optional body after blank line. example: "Refactor: rename cache_key -> cache_id". squash small commits before merging.

Local checks: `pre-commit run --all-files` and `pytest -q`. if pre-commit modifies files, re-add and push.

olivia: reviewers come from `/.github/CODEOWNERS`. if you touch serving/runtime, tag @eng-runtime or me. for infra/docker changes ping me early.
mike: changelog only for user-facing changes or bug fixes. internal refactors no.
harper: branch off main or staging?
aj: branch off main for normal work. staging is for release-team workflows.

harper: can I self-merge after approvals?
mike: generally need one approval + green CI. only owners can self-merge in their areas. docs-only PRs sometimes need just one docs reviewer.

merge-bot: CI: all checks passed ✅

harper: great — i'll squash, add a short PR body with testing steps, and ping CODEOWNERS if needed. thanks!
aj: welcome aboard, happy to give a quick 10-min repo walkthrough if you want.
